subject: Request: Temporary accelerator migration + overage buffer for CobaltAI
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@cobaltai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cobaltai.com>, Rina Gomez <rina.gomez@cobaltai.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary accelerator migration and billing buffer request

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move into Dedicated. We have a deployment window where our priority pipelines will need H200-class accelerators for 6–8 weeks to finish retraining and benchmarking. Our current commitment reserves A100s through Q3; swapping to H200 for that period will create a gap in our reservation and potential overage exposure.

Request summary:
- Temporary migration of 40 reserved slots from A100 -> H200 for up to 8 weeks starting ~2027-06-15.
- A reservation hold (no cancellation fee) for the A100 reservation for the 8-week window.
- A capped overage buffer: cap per-hour overage to no more than 1.3x our standard burst rate during the migration window.
- One-time onboarding credit to offset migration reconfiguration costs ($12k suggested).

Attached: MutualActionPlan_v2 (draft) and a short SOW.

Can we get an initial read from deal desk / finance? We need a signoff to present to our procurement team by EOD next Tuesday. Happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Sasha Patel
Head of Infra, CobaltAI
---

Hi Sasha — great to hear and congrats on the progress. Appreciate the clear asks. Quick clarifying Qs before I take to deal desk:
- Exact start date: you mentioned ~6/15. Can you confirm target start and the firm end date window?
- Confirm the 40 slots are all within one reservation (same region/us-west-2) and we keep the same model family (A100->H200).
- Is the $12k credit a hard ask or a target to offset expected reconfiguration work?

I’ll loop in deal desk and finance this morning and circle back with an initial posture. If we can lock the dates, I’ll also share a short MAP with milestones so procurement has something to review.

Call availability: today 2–4pm PT or tomorrow morning.

—Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CobaltAI migration request — need deal desk + finance posture

Team — forwarding CobaltAI request. TL;DR: customer wants to temporarily move 40 reserved slots A100->H200 for up to 8 weeks starting mid-June, and asks for: reservation hold for A100s, capped overage at 1.3x standard burst rate, and a $12k onboarding credit. Procurement needs a signoff by 2027-05-11.

My recommended posture (to expedite):
- Approve temporary hardware migration and allow reservation hold for the 8-week window (no rebooking fee) provided they return to their original reservation at period end.
- Offer capped overage at 1.25x baseline burst rate for up to 8 weeks (instead of 1.3x).
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit of $8k (below their ask) contingent on 6-month minimum post-migration commitment extension (adds to committed monthly spend).

Rationale: preserves margin vs their ask, gives sales a negotiable concession (credit vs commitment), and keeps a clear end-state.

Can deal desk + finance weigh in? If we can get an exec sign-off on the credit/commitment trade, I’ll present final terms to Sasha.

Thanks — Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CobaltAI migration request — need deal desk + finance posture

Ben — good summary. Deal desk position: we can provisionally approve Ben’s posture with one adjustment.

Notes:
- Overage cap: approve 1.25x baseline for up to 8 weeks. Finance will need a clear estimate of expected incremental revenue under that cap before final billing approval.
- Reservation hold: approve up to 8 weeks. We should document a binding return date and a rollback plan in the SOW to avoid lost capacity windows.
- Onboarding credit: counter with $8k but require a 6-month extension on the reservation term (or equivalent committed spend). The extension should be added to the Draft_SOW_CobaltAI.docx.

Action items for sales/ops:
- Ben: update SOW and MAP to include the constrained return date, rollback plan, and the commitment extension clause.
- Karthik: provide finance run-rate impact and confirm we can enable the billing cap via a temporary pricing override.
- Marissa: validate that the runtime team can schedule the temporary H200 mapping and support migration runbook.

If finance gives the green light on the credit/override, we’ll route to Aditya for final exec approval for the concession.

—Laura
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CobaltAI migration request — need deal desk + finance posture

Quick finance readout: we modeled the 8-week window and provisional numbers look acceptable with Ben’s suggested trade (1.25x cap + $8k credit in exchange for 6-month extension). Key points: 
- Expected incremental billed overage under 1.25x cap: ~$28k (8 weeks) vs unconstrained burst estimate ~$36k.
- One-time credit $8k is manageable against projected incremental revenue provided the 6-month commit extension lands.
- We can implement a temporary pricing override for the overage cap; billing will require a metadata flag on the reservation and a manual audit at month close.

I’ll prepare a short finance memo and the numeric appendix for the SOW. From my side: provisional signoff pending Aditya’s exec approval on the concession.

—Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Rina Gomez <rina.gomez@cobaltai.com>, Procurement <procurement@cobaltai.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary accelerator migration and billing buffer request — provisional terms

Hi Sasha — thanks for the patience. Internal review complete and we can confirm provisional terms to take to your procurement team: 

Summary of provisional approvals:
- Temp migration allowed: Move 40 reserved slots A100 -> H200 for up to 8 weeks starting on agreed start date (we suggested 2027-06-15). Reservation hold for the A100s approved for that window.
- Overage cap: We will set a temporary overage cap at 1.25x the standard burst rate for the 8-week window. Billing will include a manual audit at month close to ensure correct application.
- Onboarding credit: One-time $8,000 credit approved contingent on CobaltAI signing a 6-month extension to the existing reservation term (terms to be added to SOW).

Next steps:
1) I attached an updated MAP and SOW with the clauses Laura requested. Please review and confirm the start/end dates.
2) If procurement is ok, we’ll route the redlines and DocuSign link for signature. (DocuSign preview: https://docsign.example.com/abcdef123456)
3) Marissa will coordinate the migration runbook and schedule with your infra leads once the SOW is signed.

If that aligns, can procurement target 2027-05-11 for signature? If you need the credit to be larger, we can discuss trade-offs (e.g., longer commit extension).

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
